data_window: GitHub Search API queries for AI agent, coding agent, browser agent, MCP AI, RAG, LLM app, voice agent, AI workflow, copilot, automation agent and assistant repositories created or pushed from 2026-09-06 through 2026-09-08. Raw search snapshots were saved under /tmp/radar_2026_09_08_api/; selected repository metadata, root-content and README audits were saved under /tmp/radar_2026_09_08_readmes/.
source_summary: Queried 16 GitHub Search API surfaces and deduplicated 712 repositories. Reviewed metadata, topics, root files, README sections, package/Docker/test clues, install paths, demos/screenshots and API/CLI/UI claims for 51 shortlisted repositories. Some late README/root requests hit unauthenticated GitHub API rate limits, so lower-confidence candidates were kept in watchlist or skipped. No third-party repository was cloned, installed, built, executed, browser-tested, mobile-tested, provider-tested, credential-tested, payment-tested, security-tested or deployed locally.
trend_observations: The strongest product signal this window is agent infrastructure becoming operational software: context databases, portable agent rooms, multi-agent harnesses, sandbox/runtime layers, auth gateways, policy-gated PR automation and browser runtimes. Mature coding-agent CLIs remain highly active but are less useful as daily discoveries unless a distinct new product surface appears. Newly created repos are especially noisy: many are single-purpose skill packs, generated templates, benchmark state folders or unsafe session-transfer utilities. Strong runnability signals were Dockerfiles, docker-compose, package workspaces, pyproject/Cargo/Go manifests, tests, env examples, quick-start sections, screenshots, CLI folders, desktop/web UI claims and examples.
assumptions: Scores are based on GitHub API metadata and README/root-content evidence collected on 2026-09-08, not local runtime proof. Star/fork counts are raw GitHub API values at collection time and may include atypical or promotional growth; no authenticated star-delta or traffic API was used. Repositories that are mature incumbents, official vendor agents, pure skill packs, benchmarks, generated templates, security-risky session bridges or README-heavy marketing surfaces were downgraded or skipped even when active.
markdown_report: Top focus for 2026-09-08: context databases for agents, parallel coding-agent ADEs, harness abstraction, SaaS auth gateways, shared agent rooms, secure sandboxes, agentic backend platforms, source-cited memory wikis, headless browser runtimes and policy-gated PR control planes. Watchlist covers MCP artifact canvases, live voice-agent operator consoles, private email assistants, kanban schedulers for agents, local browser agents, delegated authority passes and adversarial agent-security harnesses. Skip reasons cover mature incumbents, canonical vendor tools, broad category leaders, generated skill packs, unsafe session-transfer positioning and thin benchmark/template surfaces.

top_projects.summary: Self-evolving context database that unifies agent memory, knowledge RAG and skills for long-running AI agents.
top_projects.audience: Teams building agents that need durable context, retrieval and skill memory across sessions.
top_projects.ai_native_angle: Treats memory, RAG and skills as one evolving substrate for agent work rather than separate prompt-time utilities.
top_projects.growth_signal: Created 2026-01-05, pushed 2026-09-08; GitHub API showed 35,960 stars and 2,745 forks. Root audit found Dockerfile, docker-compose, Cargo and Python package metadata, Caddyfile, docs and README quick-start/demo/MCP/CLI signals.
top_projects.runnability: High from root evidence: Docker, Python/Rust package paths and docs are present; no local provider or storage setup was tested.
top_projects.recommended_action: Review the context schema and self-evolution boundary; compare with existing automation memory and retrieval patterns.

top_projects.recommended_action: Keep watching approval, failure recovery and mobile companion patterns for long-running coding-agent work.
